findings.evidence: Lines 181-190: `let f : V × V →+ V := AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun x => R.merge x.1 x.2) ...`, `refine ⟨f.map_add, fun c x => ?_⟩`, `_ = -c • -R.merge x.1 x.2 := congrArg _ (f.map_neg x)`. `IsLinearMap.map_add`'s expected type mentions the unbundled lambda, not `⇑f`.
findings.fix: State `IsAdditive.merge_zero_zero : R.merge 0 0 = 0` and `IsAdditive.merge_neg : R.merge (-a) (-b) = -R.merge a b` in the `AddCommGroup`/`Module` section and use them; prove the `map_add` field directly with `fun x y => by simpa using hadd x.1 y.1 x.2 y.2` and drop the `let f`.
findings.issue: `isLinearMap_uncurry_iff` builds `let f : V × V →+ V := AddMonoidHom.mk' ...` only to reuse `f.map_add` (line 183) and `f.map_neg` (line 190). Both are consumed against goals stated in terms of `fun x : V × V => R.merge x.1 x.2`, so they typecheck only by unfolding the `DFunLike` coercion of `AddMonoidHom.mk'` — undocumented defeq across a bundled wrapper. It also hides two reusable consequences of `IsAdditive` inside this proof: `R.merge 0 0 = 0` (from `hadd 0 0 0 0` plus cancellation) and `R.merge (-a) (-b) = -R.merge a b`.

findings.evidence: upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Defs.lean:142: `theorem neg_smul_neg : -r • -x = r • x := by rw [neg_smul, smul_neg, neg_neg]` with `(r : R) (x : M)` explicit; line 188 already uses `rw [neg_smul_neg, neg_smul_neg]`.
findings.issue: The last calc step `_ = c • R.merge x.1 x.2 := by rw [smul_neg, neg_smul, neg_neg]` is a three-lemma chain that is exactly `neg_smul_neg`, the single lemma the same proof already applies three lines earlier (line 188).

findings.evidence: Lines 409-412: `rw [← h0]` makes the limit `𝓝 (J (R.merge a 0 ::ₘ t))`, and `hR.merge_zero a` is then passed as a simp lemma in line 412, rewriting it back to `𝓝 (J (a ::ₘ t))`.
findings.fix: Delete `h0` and `rw [← h0]`; keep `refine Tendsto.congr' (hJ.mono fun p hp => hp.symm) ?_` followed by the `simpa`.
findings.issue: In `IsUnital.tendsto_cons`, `have h0` and `rw [← h0]` are dead: `Tendsto.congr'` changes only the function, and the closing `simpa [Function.comp_def, hR.merge_zero a]` already normalises `R.merge a 0` to `a` on both sides, so the rewrite is undone by the step that follows it. The round trip obscures why the proof works.

summary: Proofs are mostly short and robust, but `isLinearMap_uncurry_iff` routes additivity through an ad-hoc bundled `AddMonoidHom` and consumes its lemmas through coercion unfolding, hiding two reusable facts about `IsAdditive`, and contains a brittle rewrite chain that duplicates a lemma it already uses. One dead rewrite in `tendsto_cons`.
